1. What is the primary purpose of the author’s distinction between language and speech in the text?A) To argue that speech is less important than signed language in linguistic studiesB) To emphasize that language is an abstract cognitive capacity, while speech is its physical manifestationC) To suggest that phonetics is irrelevant to understanding linguistic structuresD) To highlight that speech is universal, while language varies across communities
2. Which literary device is employed in the phrase “speech is the commonest and primary form of language”?A) MetaphorB) HyperboleC) AlliterationD) Understatement
3. In the context of the text, what does the word “primacy” most closely mean?A) SuperiorityB) SimplicityC) RarityD) Complexity

4. What is the syntactic function of the clause “which is physical and directly observable” in the sentence describing phonetics?A) AppositiveB) Adverbial clauseC) Relative clauseD) Independent clause

1. What is the primary grammatical function of a prepositional adverb in a sentence like “She walked past” compared to its corresponding preposition in “She walked past the house”?A) It acts as a postmodifier in a noun phrase.B) It functions without a following prepositional complement.C) It serves as the object of the verb.D) It specifies the time of the action.

2. In the example “He jumped over it,” what role does “over” play, and how does this differ from its role in “He jumped over the fence”?A) Adverb in both, but with different meanings.B) Preposition in both, but with different complements.C) Prepositional adverb in the first, preposition in the second.D) Adverbial modifier in the first, object in the second.

3. Which of the following best describes the structure of a prepositional phrase as defined in the text?A) A verb followed by a noun phrase.B) A preposition followed by a noun phrase or nominal clause.C) An adverb followed by a prepositional complement.D) A noun phrase followed by an adverbial clause.

4. What is the syntactic function of the prepositional phrase “at midnight” in the sentence “The train will start its journey at midnight”?A) It acts as a postmodifier in a noun phrase.B) It serves as a prepositional object.C) It functions as an adverbial.D) It modifies the verb as a prepositional complement.
